content: अर्दन {%a.%} .²1 Distressing, afflicting, tormenting; पुर˚, बल˚. .²2 Moving restlessly, being agitated. .{@-नः@} <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva; <ls>Mbh. 13</ls>. .{@-नम्@} [भावे-ल्युट्] Distressing, afflicting; pain, trouble, anxiety, disturbance, excitement, agitation, restlessness. .{@-नम्, -ना@} .²1 Going, moving. .²2 Asking, begging. .²3 Killing, hurting, giving pain.
